name: Avenging the Fallen
label: Quest
description: Huntsman Markhor of Revantusk Village says the Wildhammer train gryphons to slay trolls, and he wants the elder gryphons of the region, the Skylords…
intro: Huntsman Markhor of Revantusk Village says the Wildhammer train gryphons to slay trolls, and he wants the elder gryphons of the region, the Skylords, wiped out. You are to slay a Razorbeak Skylord and bring its plume back to him.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The filth that calls itself Wildhammer trains gryphon to slay troll. Horrible, I know, but worry not, justice will soon be meted out.
For now, I want you to focus on eradicating the elder gryphons of the region. They are known as Skylords.
Slay one and return to me with its plume.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Razorbeak Skylord is a much rarer breed of gryphon: One responsible for mating and creating murderous offspring.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I wonder how many of our hunters this beast devoured before you brought it to justice.
